overview: The project team hosted a community workshop to gather design input and priority feedback for the Medford High School feasibility study, which is moving toward a preferred schematic selection by June.

items.title: Project Overview and Feasibility Phase
items.summary: Project leaders introduced the current feasibility study phase and emphasized the importance of community input ahead of a critical June submission deadline.

items.title: Community Feedback Activities
items.summary: Attendees participated in interactive exercises, including a 'priorities pom-pom' vote and site design workshops, to generate a heat map of community preferences.

items.title: Project Timeline and Option Narrowing
items.summary: The committee outlined the process for narrowing dozens of design options down to a final selection for a targeted fall 2030 opening.
